name: sentinel/approve
description: Approve or reject a pending pipeline approval step. Resolves the blocking approval gate in the Rust executor.

params.name: handle
params.description: Sentinel handle ID with pending approval

params.name: approved
params.description: Whether to approve (true) or reject (false) the pending step

params.name: reason
params.description: Human-readable reason for the approval decision

params.name: approverId
params.description: UUID of the user or persona approving/rejecting

results.name: handle
results.description: The sentinel handle that was approved/rejected
